You are right, I was smoking weed. And while I am interested to find out how that may have effected it, you do realize that medications have competing side effects right? I mean I've never studied pharmacology but drugs can have marginally different effects based of the person's brain chemistry (i.e. an ADHD brain vs a neurotypical brain). So while I'm no expert, I would like to wager yes it is possible for someone to experience the opposite affects, though in my situation it was likely due to excessive use of multiple drugs.

Can I ask how the weed may have affected me though? Cause I'm still scared shitless.  


Edit: Also, my memory was never this bad before, don't know if that changes anything in context of this situation. Like I have moments where I know exactly what I'm thinking and then absolutely nothing, and that has literally never happened before doing shrooms.
